provenance.note: Krishnagiri district's rivers, groundwater and industry (scope krishnagiri-rivers; the district's own scope id is tn-krishnagiri). The district boundary is the frame and TN WRD's sub-basins, clipped to it, are the catchments (shedId): the Thenpennai's to the east, the Cauvery's Chinnar and Dodda Halla to the south-west. The industry register holds only units TNGIS matched to a land parcel, so every count is a lower bound; sector comes from the reviewed TNPCB type-code lookup pipeline-inputs/basins/krishnagiri-rivers/tnpcb-type-sectors.json.
